checks.note: Audit rows carry both ids (audit.py:86-88 rejects empty), and the type id is a content hash of the manifest, but nothing in the repo stores manifests keyed by that id and instance ids (uuid4) are not registered anywhere. Only a manifest file in the image; no lookup store is visible.

Owner is a team name only; operational_owner is an env default of the same team (settings.py:86). No CODEOWNERS, catalog or on-call/current operator mapping in the repo; may live in an outside catalog.

The only containment is a halt flag scoped to the whole fleet or a tenant (business unit); control_flags.scope is only 'fleet' or 'tenant:<bu>' (001_init.sql:96). There is no per-instance or per-agent-type stop, and halting a tenant stops every user in that business unit, and it is checked only at run start.

violates: contain the right instance or agent type without cutting off the launching user's other access
note: The only stop control is a fleet/tenant halt flag, so a single instance or agent type cannot be contained; manifest lookup and operator mapping are not shown in the repo.
